title: Rexford Industrial Announces Dates for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: LOS ANGELES, Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Rexford Industrial Realty, Inc. (the "Company" or "Rexford Industrial") (NYSE: REXR)…...
body_markdown:
LOS ANGELES


, Sept. 28, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Rexford Industrial Realty, Inc. (the "Company" or "Rexford Industrial") (NYSE: REXR) today announced that the Company will release third quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Thursday, October 22, 2026. A conference call with senior management will be held on Friday, October 23, 2026 at 11 a.m. ET.


To participate in the live telephone conference call, please access the following dial-in numbers at least five minutes prior to the start time using Meeting ID 238 759 897.


- 1 (585) 542-9983 (Local)
- 1 (833) 461-5787 (Toll-Free)


A webcast and replay of the conference call will also be available in listen-only mode at[ir.rexfordindustrial.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4784541-1&h=2076525957&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.rexfordindustrial.com%2F&a=ir.rexfordindustrial.com) .


**About Rexford Industrial**


Rexford Industrial (NYSE: REXR) transforms industrial real estate that powers the world's goods, fueling businesses, communities and everyday life. Focused exclusively on infill Southern California, the Company's portfolio of highly functional industrial properties serves the local consumption base of one of the world's largest and most economically diverse industrial markets. Through its operational expertise and disciplined execution, the Company drives value creation and long-term shareholder value. Rexford Industrial is a real estate investment trust and a member of the S&P MidCap 400 Index. For more information, please visit rexfordindustrial.com.
